system.bio:
Homebrew STTH conversion
Homebrew boss conversion. Treat reach, pattern windows and pilot survivability as encounter rules, not automatic effects. No canon STTH stats exist for this mech.

system.description: 3×3 selectable AoE; only base damage applies across the selected area. GM resolves arc and targets.
+1 Advantage; three Interacts to recharge.
Use only while landed/within reach.
Fly using the normal STTH flight rules unless the profile states otherwise.
Default mental attributes and unlisted skills use the G.U.N. Pilot / Driver profile. Set the pilot Actor UUID on the sheet.
Make 3 overhead gun pass(es), then land to fire missiles. During the missile/recovery turn, attacks aimed at the exposed cockpit gain +1 Advantage. GM tracks pattern and altitude.
Targeting the cockpit in an exposed window gains +1 Advantage. Attacks on other parts suffer +1 Disadvantage. Bonuses/penalties are homebrew STTH balance values.
Does not make breath saves.
